intro.zh: 涵蓋 Git 與 GitHub 流程、擴充 Claude Code、部署上線與 API：檢查你知道哪些保護要靠機制而非提示、金鑰與資料放哪裡。80 分通過；本測驗為課程自編練習，非 Anthropic 官方認證。
intro.en: Covers Git and GitHub, extending Claude Code, deployment and the API: do you know which safeguards need mechanisms rather than prompts, and where keys and data belong? Pass at 80. A course-made practice quiz, not an official Anthropic certification.

q.zh: 你請 Claude Code 把修好的家用記帳小工具建立 PR。送出前，最合理的一步是什麼？
q.en: You asked Claude Code to open a PR for your fixed home budgeting tool. What is the most sensible step before submitting?

opts.zh: 先讀過 Claude 產生的 PR 描述與變更內容，必要時請它補強
opts.en: Read the PR description and changes Claude produced, and ask it to improve them if needed

opts.zh: 因為是 Claude 寫的，直接合併
opts.en: Merge straight away because Claude wrote it

opts.zh: 刪掉描述，讓審查者自己猜
opts.en: Delete the description and let reviewers guess

opts.zh: 把所有變更壓成一個無說明的 commit
opts.en: Squash everything into one commit with no message

why.zh: Claude 能建立 PR，但送出前仍要由人審查，描述不足可再請它補強。
why.en: Claude can open a PR, but a person reviews it before submission; weak descriptions can be improved on request.

q.zh: 團隊想在 PR 留言 @claude 讓它分析並修改，關於權限與合併，下列哪項正確？
q.en: Your team wants to comment @claude on a PR so it analyzes and edits. Which statement about permissions and merging is correct?

opts.zh: 任何訪客留言都能觸發，且 Claude 的變更可免審查合併
opts.en: Any visitor's comment can trigger it, and its changes can merge without review

opts.zh: 只有 CLAUDE.md 寫了名字的人能觸發
opts.en: Only people named in CLAUDE.md can trigger it

opts.zh: 觸發者需有儲存庫寫入權限，且合併前仍要審查 Claude 的變更
opts.en: The trigger needs repository write access, and Claude's changes are still reviewed before merging

opts.zh: 必須先關閉所有 CI 檢查
opts.en: All CI checks must be turned off first

why.zh: GitHub Actions 整合要求觸發者具寫入權限；Claude 的變更和人寫的一樣要審查後才合併。
why.en: The GitHub Actions integration requires write access from the trigger, and Claude's changes get reviewed like anyone's before merging.

q.zh: 風場運維專案的 CLAUDE.md 寫了「不得修改 /scada/config」。要真正擋下這類動作，應該怎麼做？
q.en: A wind O&M project's CLAUDE.md says 'never edit /scada/config'. To actually block such an action, what should you do?

opts.zh: 把這句話重複寫三遍
opts.en: Repeat the sentence three times

opts.zh: 加上 PreToolUse hook，以 exit code 2 擋下動作
opts.en: Add a PreToolUse hook that blocks the action with exit code 2

opts.zh: 改用更長的 CLAUDE.md
opts.en: Make the CLAUDE.md longer

opts.zh: 請 Claude 保證不會違反
opts.en: Ask Claude to promise it will comply

why.zh: CLAUDE.md 是上下文而非強制設定；hook 才能以 exit code 2 真正阻擋工具動作。
why.en: CLAUDE.md is context, not enforcement; a hook can truly block a tool action with exit code 2.

q.zh: 同事分享一個專案的 .mcp.json，裡面有你不認識的 MCP 伺服器。最安全的做法是？
q.en: A colleague shares a project .mcp.json listing an MCP server you don't recognise. What is the safest approach?

opts.zh: 連線後再看有沒有問題
opts.en: Connect first and see if anything breaks

opts.zh: 先確認來源可信再核准；只連線可信的伺服器，避免提示注入
opts.en: Verify the source is trustworthy before approving; connect only to trusted servers to avoid prompt injection

opts.zh: 因為在專案裡，所以一定安全
opts.en: It is in the project, so it must be safe

opts.zh: 把伺服器權限全部開到最大
opts.en: Grant the server maximum permissions

why.zh: 專案範圍的伺服器首次使用需核准；不明來源的伺服器可能帶來提示注入風險。
why.en: Project-scope servers need approval on first use; unknown servers can bring prompt-injection risk.

q.zh: 你的課程動畫要放上 GitHub Pages。下列哪種內容最適合這種服務？
q.en: You want to host course animations on GitHub Pages. What kind of content fits this service best?

opts.zh: 需要資料庫與伺服器端程式的會員系統
opts.en: A member system needing a database and server-side code

opts.zh: 存放客戶個資的內部報表
opts.en: Internal reports holding customer personal data

opts.zh: 含 PLC 連線密碼的設定檔
opts.en: Config files containing PLC passwords

opts.zh: 由 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 組成的靜態網站
opts.en: A static site made of HTML, CSS and JavaScript

why.zh: GitHub Pages 適合靜態網站；公開網站也不應放入內部或個資資料。
why.en: GitHub Pages suits static sites, and a public site should never hold internal or personal data.

q.zh: 要把自訂網域 example.tw（頂級網域）與 www.example.tw 指向 Pages，DNS 該怎麼設？
q.en: To point custom domain example.tw (apex) and www.example.tw at Pages, how should DNS be set?

opts.zh: 頂級網域用 A、ALIAS 或 ANAME 記錄，www 子網域用 CNAME 記錄
opts.en: Apex uses A, ALIAS or ANAME records; the www subdomain uses a CNAME record

opts.zh: 兩者都只能用 CNAME
opts.en: Both must use CNAME only

opts.zh: 兩者都只能用 TXT 記錄
opts.en: Both must use TXT records only

opts.zh: 不需設定 DNS，GitHub 會自動搶下網域
opts.en: No DNS needed; GitHub claims the domain automatically

why.zh: 頂級網域用 A／ALIAS／ANAME，www 子網域用 CNAME；HTTPS 選項在設定網域後可能需等待。
why.en: Apex domains use A/ALIAS/ANAME, www uses CNAME; the HTTPS option may take time to appear after setup.

topic.zh: 用 API 打造 AI 應用

q.zh: 為風機手冊問答 App 呼叫 Messages API，下列哪項描述正確？
q.en: You call the Messages API for a turbine-manual Q&A app. Which description is correct?

opts.zh: model、max_tokens、messages 為必填，system 是頂層選填參數
opts.en: model, max_tokens and messages are required; system is an optional top-level parameter

opts.zh: system 必須放在 messages 陣列的最後一項
opts.en: system must be the last item of the messages array

opts.zh: 只需提供 messages，其餘由伺服器猜
opts.en: Only messages is needed; the server guesses the rest

opts.zh: 金鑰要寫在前端網頁讓使用者自行填入
opts.en: Put the key in the front-end page for users to fill in

why.zh: 必填欄位是 model、max_tokens、messages；金鑰放在 x-api-key 標頭，且應只存在伺服器端。
why.en: Required fields are model, max_tokens and messages; the key goes in the x-api-key header and stays server-side.

topic.zh: 用 API 打造 AI 應用

q.zh: Claude 回傳 stop_reason 為 tool_use，要查家裡電費的自訂工具。接下來誰做什麼？
q.en: Claude returns stop_reason tool_use for a custom tool that looks up a home's power bill. Who does what next?

opts.zh: Claude 在 Anthropic 伺服器上直接執行你的函式
opts.en: Claude runs your function directly on Anthropic's servers

opts.zh: 你的應用程式執行工具，再用 tool_result 把結果送回
opts.en: Your application runs the tool, then sends the result back as tool_result

opts.zh: 停止對話，tool_use 代表錯誤
opts.en: Stop the conversation; tool_use signals an error

opts.zh: 使用者手動複製結果貼進新對話
opts.en: The user manually pastes the result into a new chat

why.zh: 自訂工具由你的應用程式執行，結果以 tool_result 送回，Claude 再接著回答。
why.en: Custom tools are executed by your app; the result returns as tool_result and Claude continues.
